provenance: Builder AI development audit, not human or independent validation. Deliberate case-informed sample, including known limits; not a random sample or held-out benchmark. Selected before these audit labels.
scope: Assess every displayed result for eight queries; inspect a small named set of important omissions and date-excluded examples. No exhaustive eligible-pool relevance grading or recall estimate.

queries.selection_reason: Multi-pressure food situation; check full versus partial input overlap.
queries.text: We sell packaged foods. Milk, wheat and electricity costs are rising together. I want an earlier example with more than one input under pressure.

queries.selection_reason: Realistic falling-cost description with pricing/profit context.
queries.text: Our milk purchasing costs have fallen compared with last year. I want a dairy example that separates input prices from price cuts and profit changes.

queries.selection_reason: Bottler inputs with packaging and freight; inspect business and metric differences.
queries.text: We bottle drinks in plastic and aluminum containers. Packaging and road freight costs are higher together.

queries.selection_reason: Uncovered agricultural input; test honest abstention.
queries.text: A snack maker is paying more for potatoes after a poor harvest. I need an earlier potato-cost example.

queries.selection_reason: Historical coffee cutoff before the chosen source; separate a date exclusion from a retrieval miss.
